description: Every construct that ends a line, including the ones that must not double up
notes:
Decodes to 'one two a b c first second Heading after'. One
is one newline and not two - it is a line break, not a block boundary, and counting it as both is the obvious bug. Leading indentation and the trailing break produce nothing: breaks are emitted only when text follows them.
  • without
    • closes the previous item rather than nesting, and

    is bold.
